achievements.hint:
POINT OF NO RETURN: Sanguis/Dog boss fight. Regardless, do prioritize these since some are well hidden.
There's a guide showing all the locations of the stars and lockers under the "checklists" section.
At the very beginning of the game, when you gotta use your apartment keys to enter Ivan's Apartment... don't. Keep on interacting with the closed door 10 times to get the achievement.

The first time that you get to the 2nd floor apartment, head to the room next to the tv, where the computers and the revolver is. There you'll find a picture of Iván. Interact with it 5 times to get the achievement.

achievements.description: Kill two or more enemies at once (not Carnitos)
achievements.hint: Easily doable in the hallways outside the elevators. If there's a single enemy, leave em alone so they stack with the next respawned enemies. Easier to do with Shotgun or Wrench. Just be sure to save before attempting and just tank the hit.

achievements.description: Kill three Carnitos with one hit
achievements.hint: Carnitos is the third boss. You are able to get there after using the "Chisel" key item. It'll spawn enemies that die in one hit with any weapon. Just stack them together and hit away!

Near the end of the game, when going for Ending #2, kill all relicta ghosts. Not just the ones on the way to Séptimo Arte, but the ones in every floor too.
NOTE: I tried this achievement a total of three times since it had troubles registering the kills. Avoid multikills and stay until the gold particles go away just in case.

achievements.description: Escape from a Vorax to another room before he explodes
achievements.hint:
Only doable with guns. If you're doing "Wrench Queen" feel free use the gun and then reload a prior save.
Shoot the fat enemies (Vorax) until they get red and start running at you then switch rooms. You'll hear an explosion once it is safe to go back. Regardless, you don't need to go back to get the achievement.
During the "dog boss fight" (Sanguis), bait the attacks of the boss towards the standing mannequins for the boss to break em. Be careful not to accidentally kill the boss.

achievements.description: Keep going down the endless corridor
achievements.hint: One of the last puzzles of the game have you going through an infinite green corridor. Just keep going left until you get the cheevo.
The iron pipe is found in the bathroom and requires the screwdiver to obtain. You can get the screwdiver on top of a box in the stairs of the place where you can watch the reels.
Story Achievement, impossible to miss.

achievements.description: Drink Lavendoleum while having full health
Complete the game using only the wrench
achievements.hint: Self explanatory for the most part. As long as you don't "use" (shoot, attack, aim) weapons, it should be fine.

achievements.description: Defeat the carnitos without getting hit
achievements.hint:
Carnitos is the third boss. You are able to get there after using the "Chisel" key item.
I found a blindspot that kinda breaks the AI. just stand at the bottom right corner and shoot or, if you're doing Wrench Queen, get out enough for the enemies to chase you and it's still a great spot, you'll just have to time your hits well.

achievements.description: Defeat Obscuratus using only the wrench
achievements.hint:
*Feel free to pair this with Wrench Queen.
Obscuratus is the first boss of the game, located in the room full of candles that you enter by the window.

achievements.description: Defeat Fumus using only the pipe
achievements.hint:
*Do note this will invalidate the Wrench Queen achievement! So be sure to reload a prior save if you are going for that.
Fumus is the second boss that you get after you use the animal skull key item. It's the one that has a hole in the middle of their face. Just kill them with the pipe you get from the bar's bathroom.

achievements.description: Fill the silver bottle by removing 3 save points
achievements.hint: Story Achievement, impossible to miss.

achievements.description: Read all the pages of the old book
achievements.hint: Story achievement, you can technically miss this by finishing the game without reading the book. Please, before the game ends, make sure to have read all the pages.

Lacuna is the boss you'll get when going for Ending #1. 
During Phase 1, she'll have this attack where she screams, jump and then land. Stay still when that happens to get grabbed and killed.

Hermes is the boss you'll get when going for Ending #2.
During phase 2, you'll be able to see the mouth. Just get close/inside the mouth until you die and get the achievement.

*You might want to save ASAP to try the other ending later.
After obtaining the Aurifer (yellow knife), don't kill any of the Relicta and enter the Séptimo Arte Theather/Gallery.

*You might want to save ASAP to try the other ending.
*You might want to combine this with the "Heart of Lead" missable achievement.
After obtaining the Aurifer (yellow knife), kill a lot of Relicta and enter the Séptimo Arte Theather/Gallery.

After getting ending #1 and #2, start a new run, then pickup the book at the table.
We'll have to get somewhat far into the game, doing alternate solutions to puzzles we already did *before they are completed*.
With the bible obtained, now we have to:
*Get to the second floor apartment and use the bible on the TV with static. You'll be told what to do (Step on Male/Mars symbol and hit every symbol counterclockwise 6 times). After you're done, pick up the red cross.
*Go to the Community Center (where you watch the film reels and obtain their items) and instead of inputting the normal combination, use the bible and input the combination that the cutscene shows.
*Go to Floor 0 and obtain the yellow cable then enter the green door and use the bible inside the room. Put the cable and cycle through the camera 6 times (or just spam the shit out of the camera).
After the bible is used in any of those places you'll get an inverted red cross. Bring them to the street outside Séptimo Arte, where you'll find a spot to put the inverted crosses on. Put them there and then enter the door. You'll know what to do there.
After getting ending #1 and #2, start a new run and immediately turn around and use the keys to go out of the apartment complex.
